reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Enable the ops E2E test suite by @negz in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6629", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Turning on the ops E2E test suite is a change to project testing. The evidence states no effect on deployed environments.

proposed.statement: Crossplane's ops end-to-end test suite was turned on in the project's own testing, which has no operational consequence for operators.
